description: Update the status of a comment thread in a pull request (repositoryId optional; derived from pullRequestId when omitted)

organizationId.description: The ID or name of the organization (Default: unknown-organization)

projectId.description: The ID or name of the project (Default: no default project)

pullRequestId.description: The ID of the pull request

repositoryId.description: The ID or name of the repository (optional; derived from pullRequestId when omitted)

status.description: The status to set on the thread

threadId.description: The ID of the thread to update

name: update_pull_request_thread_status
